_comment: Registry for beben.design/tools/. Read by scripts/build_tools.py.
Every entry renders a card on /tools/. Entries with status 'live' and no
'external_url' are also rendered into docs/<slug>/index.html from
content/tools/<slug>/ (body.html, tool.css, tool.js, optional vendor/*.js)
wrapped in scripts/templates/tool.html.
Fields:
slug              output folder under docs/ and the URL
name              card title
tag               card tag: Utility, Generator, or Arcade
pillar            featured | private | design | business (grid grouping)
status            live | soon
description       card copy, one or two sentences
external_url      set for cards that link somewhere already built (the arcade)
banner            optional CSS url() for the visual card variant
number            the [ TOOLS.nn ] label on the tool page
h1                tool page headline; '|' becomes a line break and the
last segment is wrapped in the red highlight box
lead              tool page intro paragraph
meta_title        <title> and og:title
meta_description  meta description and og:description
specs             [label, value] or [label, value, 'accent'] rows
toast             initial text of the toast element
run_modes         what you can do with the tool, rendered as badges on
the card. Live tools only, because the build verifies
every mode against what was actually produced:
browser    runs in the tab, nothing leaves it. The
build fails this if the generated page
has an off-site script or a network call
download   one standalone HTML file. Only valid for
tools this script generates a file for
self-host  serve that file yourself. Needs download
install    add to a home screen and open it offline
Copy rule from the README: no em dashes anywhere.

tools.name: Beben Arcade
tools.description: Twelve tiny 8-bit games. Add it to your home screen, play offline, beat your best. No ads, ever.

tools.name: QR Code Generator
tools.description: Make unlimited free QR codes with custom colors, patterns, frames, and logos. No sign-up, no watermark.
tools.lead: Make unlimited free QR codes from any URL, text, phone number, or contact info. Customize the pattern, colors, finders, frame, and logo, then export SVG or PNG. No watermarks, no limits, no data leaves your browser.
tools.meta_title: Free QR Code Generator, Customizable and Unlimited - Beben Design
tools.meta_description: Make unlimited free QR codes with custom colors, patterns, frames, and logos. Export SVG or PNG. No sign-up, no watermark, works offline.

tools.name: Contrast Grid
tools.description: Paste a whole palette, get every foreground and background pair scored against WCAG AA and AAA at once.
tools.lead: Most checkers test one pair at a time. Paste your entire palette and this one scores every combination against WCAG AA and AAA in a single matrix, so you can see which pairs are actually safe to ship.
tools.meta_title: Contrast Grid - WCAG Palette Checker - Beben Design Tools
tools.meta_description: Check every colour pair in your palette against WCAG AA and AAA at once. Free contrast matrix tool that runs entirely in your browser, no sign-up, works offline.

tools.name: Colour Blindness Simulator
tools.description: Push an image or a palette through protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, and achromatopsia.

tools.name: SVG Cleaner
tools.description: Strip the cruft Figma and Illustrator leave behind, round the decimals, and see the bytes you saved.

tools.name: Favicon Forge
tools.description: One image in, every favicon size out, plus the web manifest and the exact link tags to paste.

tools.name: Fluid Type Calculator
tools.description: Min and max viewport, min and max size, out comes one clamp() line that scales cleanly between them.

tools.name: Dither Machine
tools.description: Drop an image and push it through Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, or ordered Bayer dithering. Export the PNG.
tools.lead: The 1-bit look that made early Macintosh screens legible, applied to any image you drop in. Pick an algorithm, set the pixel scale, export a PNG. Your image is read straight off the disk and never uploaded.
tools.meta_title: Dither Machine - 1-Bit Image Dithering - Beben Design Tools
tools.meta_description: Convert any image to 1-bit dithered art with Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, or Bayer algorithms. Free browser tool, nothing uploaded, works offline.
specs: PNG at the source pixel size
None, the file is read locally

tools.name: EXIF Viewer and Stripper
tools.description: See the GPS coordinates, camera serial, and timestamps hidden in a photo, then download a clean copy.
tools.lead: Drop a photo and see what it carries beyond the image: GPS coordinates, camera make and serial, capture times, software, and orientation. Then download a copy with the metadata stripped. JPEG, PNG, WebP, and HEIC/HEIF files are read locally and never uploaded.
tools.meta_title: EXIF Viewer and Stripper - Remove Photo Metadata - Beben Design Tools
tools.meta_description: View the GPS, camera serial, and timestamps hidden in a photo, then download a clean copy with the metadata stripped. Runs in your browser. No upload.

tools.name: Checksum Verifier
tools.description: Hash a downloaded file with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 and compare it to the published value.
tools.lead: Drop a download and hash it with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512, then paste the value the publisher listed. The tool compares them and tells you whether the file is the one you asked for. Nothing is uploaded.
tools.meta_title: Checksum Verifier - SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 - Beben Design Tools
tools.meta_description: Hash a downloaded file with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 and compare it with the published checksum. Free browser tool, nothing uploaded.

tools.name: Text Diff
tools.description: Compare two revisions of a contract or a copy deck side by side, without uploading either one.
tools.lead: Paste two revisions of a contract, a copy deck, or a config file and see every line added, removed, or changed side by side. Ignore case or whitespace when those differences do not matter. Neither version leaves your browser.
tools.meta_title: Text Diff - Compare Two Revisions Side by Side - Beben Design Tools
tools.meta_description: Compare two versions of a document side by side, with line and word highlights. Ignore case or whitespace. Free browser tool, nothing uploaded, works offline.
specs: Paste or load two text files

tools.name: JWT Decoder
tools.description: Read the header, payload, and expiry of a token without pasting it into somebody else's server.

tools.name: Passphrase Generator
tools.description: Diceware passphrases you can actually remember, drawn from your browser's cryptographic randomness.

tools.name: Does It Fit?
tools.description: One text box, checked live against every limit that matters: title tags, meta descriptions, posts, subject lines.
tools.lead: Every platform truncates at a different place and none of them warn you first. Type once and watch the counts against title tags, meta descriptions, social posts, and subject lines all at the same time.
tools.meta_title: Does It Fit? Character Counter for Every Platform - Beben Design Tools
tools.meta_description: Count characters against title tag, meta description, X, LinkedIn, and email subject limits at once. Free browser tool, no sign-up, works offline.

tools.name: Invoice Builder
tools.description: Line items in, a properly typeset invoice out. Print it straight to PDF, no account and no watermark.

tools.name: Freelance Rate Calculator
tools.description: Target income, overheads, holidays, and real billable days, worked back into the rate you should quote.

tools.name: Screenshot Framer
tools.description: Drop a screenshot, add padding, a backdrop, rounded corners, and a shadow. Export something worth posting.

tools.name: Barcode Generator
tools.description: EAN-13 and Code 128 barcodes as clean vectors, for stock labels, shelf tags, and small inventories.
